data: Which of the following values are considered in figure 10 for λrel?

The left graph in Figure 10 shows the variation of RMSE with respect to λrev while keeping λrel constant at different values. The legend indicates the following values for λrel: 0.00005, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.005, and 0.01. These values are represented by different colored lines in the graph. Therefore, the values considered in Figure 10 for λrel are 0.00005, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.005, and 0.01.
